title: The Hard Drop
premise: Mara Iversen's quiet life laundering audits for a shell company collapses when her dead handler, Tomas, sends a calendar invite for a meeting he can no longer attend — and the invite is live-tracked by whoever killed him. Following it, she discovers Tomas was investigating Vantage Logistics, whose founder, Aldous Rehn, launders not money but people: moving an assassin through freight channels to stage a 'cargo accident' at the Kestrel border checkpoint. Mara must decode Tomas's dead-drop ledger, ally with his estranged daughter Nia (a checkpoint guard who never knew her father), and expose Rehn before the shift change at dawn. She stops the attack but chooses to burn her own clean identity to do it — trading belonging in a lie for a fragile, real family with Nia.
about_author: Rafael Okonkwo is a former port auditor who spent six years tracing freight fraud across West African and Baltic shipping lanes before turning to fiction. He writes thrillers about paper trails, believing the most dangerous things move on schedules no one reads.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: POV: Mara. Two weeks after burying Tomas, Mara receives a meeting invitation from his still-active account, scheduled for tomorrow at 9 p.m. When she arrives at the dead-drop café, she finds it already crawling with men who aren't police — and realizes the invitation wasn't for her; it was bait, and she walked into it. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into survival instinct as her polished lie begins to crack.

chapters.title: Ledger of the Dead
chapters.summary: POV: Mara, alternating with Nia. Escaping the café through Tomas's old escape route, Mara retrieves his hidden ledger and decodes entries pointing to Vantage Logistics and a shipment marked only 'HARD DROP.' Meanwhile, checkpoint guard Nia Iversen-Okoye investigates her father's death and finds his last call was to Mara. The two women meet, hostile and grieving. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance forged from shared loss.

chapters.title: Shift Change
chapters.summary: POV: Nia, with Mara. Inside Vantage, Mara confronts Rehn, who offers her Tomas's job — revealing he built her entire clean life as a leash. She plays along long enough to learn the attack targets the checkpoint during the 4 a.m. shift change, disguised as a tanker fire. Nia must rotate the roster without alerting Rehn's mole inside the guard unit. Emotional beat: power's seduction met and refused; trust tested under time pressure.

chapters.title: The Hard Drop
chapters.summary: POV: Alternating Mara/Nia, converging. At the checkpoint, Mara triggers the freight manifest alarm while Nia reroutes the shift change, forcing the assassin's truck into an unplanned inspection where the weapon is found. Rehn's network unravels publicly; Mara submits evidence that also exposes her own complicity, surrendering her clean identity. Weeks later, she and Nia share coffee at the rebuilt checkpoint. Emotional beat: costly victory, and belonging finally earned instead of purchased.
